<?php

class TenantContext {
    private string $tenantId;
    private string $sessionToken;
    
    public function __construct(string $tenantId, string $sessionToken) {
        $this->tenantId = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $tenantId);
        $this->sessionToken = $sessionToken;
    }
    
    public function getTenantId(): string {
        return $this->tenantId;
    }
    
    public function getSessionToken(): string {
        return $this->sessionToken;
    }
}

class CacheKeyBuilder {
    private const NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR = '::';
    private const TENANT_PREFIX = 'tenant';
    
    public function buildKey(string $tenantId, string $userKey): string {
        $namespace = self::TENANT_PREFIX . self::NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR . $tenantId;
        return $namespace . self::NAMESPACE_SEPARATOR . $this->sanitizeKey($userKey);
    }
    
    private function sanitizeKey(string $key): string {
        return preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]/', '_', $key);
    }
}

class DistributedCacheClient {
    private $redis;
    private CacheKeyBuilder $keyBuilder;
    private array $tenantQuotas;
    private array $lockRegistry = [];
    
    public function __construct($redis, array $tenantQuotas = []) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->keyBuilder = new CacheKeyBuilder();
        $this->tenantQuotas = $tenantQuotas;
    }
    
    public function get(TenantContext $ctx, string $key): ?string {
        $fullKey = $this->keyBuilder->buildKey($ctx->getTenantId(), $key);
        $this->acquireReadLock($ctx, $fullKey);
        try {
            $value = $this->redis->get($fullKey);
            return $value !== false ? $value : null;
        } finally {
            $this->releaseReadLock($ctx, $fullKey);
        }
    }
    
    public function set(TenantContext $ctx, string $key, string $value, int $ttl = 3600): bool {
        $fullKey = $this->keyBuilder->buildKey($ctx->getTenantId(), $key);
        
        if (!$this->checkQuota($ctx)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Tenant quota exceeded');
        }
        
        $this->acquireWriteLock($ctx, $fullKey);
        try {
            return $this->redis->setex($fullKey, $ttl, $value);
        } finally {
            $this->releaseWriteLock($ctx, $fullKey);
        }
    }
    
    public function delete(TenantContext $ctx, string $key): bool {
        $fullKey = $this->keyBuilder->buildKey($ctx->getTenantId(), $key);
        $this->acquireWriteLock($ctx, $fullKey);
        try {
            return $this->redis->del($fullKey) > 0;
        } finally {
            $this->releaseWriteLock($ctx, $fullKey);
        }
    }
    
    public function getOrSet(TenantContext $ctx, string $key, callable $factory, int $ttl = 3600): string {
        $fullKey = $this->keyBuilder->buildKey($ctx->getTenantId(), $key);
        
        // Phase 1: Check if value exists (read phase)
        $existing = $this->redis->get($fullKey);
        if ($existing !== false) {
            return $existing;
        }
        
        // Phase 2: Acquire distributed lock for population
        $lockKey = $this->buildLockKey($fullKey);
        $lockAcquired = $this->redis->set($lockKey, $ctx->getTenantId(), ['NX', 'EX' => 5]);
        
        if (!$lockAcquired) {
            // Another process is populating; wait and retry
            usleep(50000);
            $retryValue = $this->redis->get($fullKey);
            return $retryValue !== false ? $retryValue : '';
        }
        
        try {
            // Phase 3: Re-verify ownership before write
            $lockOwner = $this->redis->get($lockKey);
            if ($lockOwner !== $ctx->getTenantId()) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Lock ownership verification failed');
            }
            
            // Phase 4: Generate and store value
            $value = $factory();
            $this->redis->setex($fullKey, $ttl, $value);
            return $value;
        } finally {
            // Phase 5: Release lock - verify we still own it
            $currentOwner = $this->redis->get($lockKey);
            if ($currentOwner === $ctx->getTenantId()) {
                $this->redis->del($lockKey);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public function multiTenantBatchInvalidate(TenantContext $ctx, array $patterns): int {
        $count = 0;
        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
            $searchPattern = $this->keyBuilder->buildKey($ctx->getTenantId(), $pattern);
            
            // Validate the resolved pattern still belongs to this tenant
            $tenantPrefix = 'tenant::' . $ctx->getTenantId() . '::';
            if (strpos($searchPattern, $tenantPrefix) !== 0) {
                continue;
            }
            
            $keys = $this->redis->keys($searchPattern);
            foreach ($keys as $key) {
                // Re-validate each key at deletion time
                if ($this->validateKeyOwnership($ctx->getTenantId(), $key)) {
                    $this->redis->del($key);
                    $count++;
                }
            }
        }
        return $count;
    }
    
    private function validateKeyOwnership(string $tenantId, string $key): bool {
        $expectedPrefix = 'tenant::' . $tenantId . '::';
        return strpos($key, $expectedPrefix) === 0;
    }
    
    private function buildLockKey(string $key): string {
        return '__lock::' . $key;
    }
    
    private function checkQuota(TenantContext $ctx): bool {
        $tenantId = $ctx->getTenantId();
        $quota = $this->tenantQuotas[$tenantId] ?? 10000;
        $usageKey = 'tenant::' . $tenantId . '::__usage_counter';
        $current = (int)$this->redis->get($usageKey);
        return $current < $quota;
    }
    
    private function acquireReadLock(TenantContext $ctx, string $key): void {
        $lockKey = '__rlock::' . $key . '::' . $ctx->getSessionToken();
        $this->redis->set($lockKey, '1', ['NX', 'EX' => 30]);
        $this->lockRegistry[$lockKey] = true;
    }
    
    private function releaseReadLock(TenantContext $ctx, string $key): void {
        $lockKey = '__rlock::' . $key . '::' . $ctx->getSessionToken();
        if (isset($this->lockRegistry[$lockKey])) {
            $this->redis->del($lockKey);
            unset($this->lockRegistry[$lockKey]);
        }
    }
    
    private function acquireWriteLock(TenantContext $ctx, string $key): void {
        $lockKey = '__wlock::' . $key;
        $maxRetries = 50;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $maxRetries; $i++) {
            $acquired = $this->redis->set($lockKey, $ctx->getSessionToken(), ['NX', 'EX' => 10]);
            if ($acquired) {
                $this->lockRegistry[$lockKey] = true;
                return;
            }
            usleep(100000);
        }
        throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to acquire write lock');
    }
    
    private function releaseWriteLock(TenantContext $ctx, string $key): void {
        $lockKey = '__wlock::' . $key;
        if (isset($this->lockRegistry[$lockKey])) {
            $owner = $this->redis->get($lockKey);
            if ($owner === $ctx->getSessionToken()) {
                $this->redis->del($lockKey);
            }
            unset($this->lockRegistry[$lockKey]);
        }
    }
}
